chidori_hand.label: The activated Chidori's lightning in the near hand: his two paint-overs' lightning (the vest's ring and bolts, the coat's burst) flickering ('charged'); anchor: his fist

ground_crack.label: Ground cracked under a charged ninja's step (difficult terrain while it shows): four variants in 'idle', one per cell; 'open_<variant>' splits it open; 'glow' is the lightning left in its depths (two flickers per variant, drawn over it, fading); anchor: its middle on the ground

ground_crack_dust.label: The dust and chips of ground thrown up as a crack opens under a charged ninja's step ('puff', once); anchor: the crack's middle on the ground
